items.claim: Gillian Robertson has a ridiculous top game and is one of the most violent fighters in the world when she gets to top position.
items.quote: Gillian Robertson, when she gets to her spot on top, is one of the more violent fighters in the world, right? Her top game is ridiculous.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern buries Gillian Robertson on the feet because Gillian's striking is not rated at all.
items.quote: Mackenzie Dern buries her on the feet. Because I would consider Mackenzie Dern's striking style to be very much fighting you, right?

items.claim: Charles Johnson has to get hit to wake up and takes too long to get out of first gear.
items.quote: He has to get hit to wake up a little bit... Just takes too long to get out of first gear.

items.claim: Dustin Stoltzfus has bad fight IQ and makes lapses in judgment.
items.quote: He has lapses in judgment. The fight IQ is probably his biggest hurdle.

items.claim: Esteban Ribovics will drown Edson Barboza with his pace, cardio, and volume.
items.quote: He's just going to drown Edson with his pace, with his cardio, with his volume.

items.claim: Edson Barboza is 40 years old and at the end of the line in his career.
items.quote: Edson Barboza's a man, he's 40. At this point, I'm not expecting him to pull a rabbit out of the hat.

items.claim: Chidi Njokuani's cardio is not rated all that much and he works exclusively off the back foot.
items.quote: I don't rate Chidi's cardio all that much and he lets guys kind of work off of the front foot while he elects to counter strike.
